save.text: Liam is remote via Internet; appears on Twitch and audio works.
Matt and Marisha will be guests at Tekko in Pittsburgh, Apr 8–10; panels/signings.
Gilmore’s Glorious Goods shirt pre-order ends ‘tomorrow at midnight’; group unclear—Matt advises order tonight to be safe.
Two new shirts went up at 6:30 today for one-week pre-order; limited immediate stock; working to expand sizing.
Sam is voice directing DreamWorks’ Home TV cartoon; announced today; releases in a week.
Tonight is episode 47; episode 50 will be special with surprises; Critmas blowout right after ep 50.
Wyrmwood Gaming promo: use code “critrole”.
Wyrmwood promo adds: free shipping available (from Liam).
Marisha: her last episode as current Signal Boost host airs Tuesday; hosts rotate; she continues as producer.
Liam remote location detail: playing from his childhood kitchen, first room he ever played D&D in.
Scanlan casts Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion to house the group/refugees; door appears, ethereal servants attend.
Mansion can admit any designated creatures; about 35 Pyrah present incl. Zephrah; Scanlan invites them in.
Grog (Travis) attacked mansion servants thinking they were ghosts; Craven Edge disperses three attendants.
Scanlan confirms MMM is a newly acquired skill; he hadn’t used it before.
MMM staff obey; food/drink solid inside; items dissipate when carried outside the door.
Rooms: each PC has a room upstairs; Scanlan’s is largest at hall end; adjacent rooms reserved for Pike and for Kaylie.
MMM can be cast once per day; casting time is 1 minute; entry is invite-only.
Servants can fetch limited resources; conjured spectral items like a cow have substance but no blood and can disperse.
Rooms update: Vex moves her bed to the large basement training area with high ceilings; Grog plans to train there too; Kaylie’s room is locked.
Basement training room revealed via new doorway: sand pit, brick, chains for climbing/lifting, training dummies, basic weapons and armor racks.
Vex tried to ride a broom from the Bag of Holding; commanded it to fly with various phrases and accent; broom did nothing, so she put it back.
Trinket performed a charging attack on Grog for training: +8 attack bonus; hit AC 23; dealt 7 bludgeoning; Grog made STR save (26) and was not knocked prone.
Scanlan examined Gern’s stolen broom; Arcana 14 revealed command phrase needed; Investigation 21 found hidden runes with archaic Draconic word.
Keyleth admits she’s poor at arcane identification; senses magic but only knows nature-based magic.
The broom’s hidden command word is archaic Draconic for “candle”; saying it activated the broom and it lifted in Laura/Vex’s hands.
Broom flies by saying archaic Draconic word; Vex successfully pilots it despite exhaustion after DEX check 20.
Scanlan secures a promise from Vex to help someone he picks later to repay stealing Gern’s broom.
Cerkonos visits Keyleth at night; his severed arm is visibly regenerating; he feels unease and asks to talk privately.
Cerkonos reveals a Pyrah acolyte named Raishan tore open the Fire Ashari Gate months ago, releasing Thordak; she arrived ~4 years prior seeking redemption, seemed human, ~19-20 now, nature uncertain.
Raishan identified by the group/Matt as the green dragon of the Conclave who attacked Emon; Keyleth resolves to watch for the name and send word.
Vax dream: Raven Queen shows his fate thread, calls him fate-touched; offers ‘Rebirth or ruin. Maker or martyr. Conqueror, tyrant, or nothing,’ then snaps the thread; he falls into darkness.
Vex admits to the group she stole Gern’s broom (necromancer/candlemaker) and plans to keep it; others recall stealing a carpet; most don’t judge.
Breakfast in Scanlan’s mansion; question raised if items persist after leaving—unknown to party.
Grog has a disturbing dream of mass slaughter; Kevdak appears proud as herd kneels before Grog; he wakes unsettled.
Vex test-flies Gern’s stolen broom at breakfast; can shoot while flying with difficulty; plans to keep it and practice.
Percy agrees to engineer a seat/stabilizer for Vex’s broom; may need funds; Vex will pay.
Liam is remote via Internet; appears on Twitch and audio works. Also jokes Vex will look like a Byroden chimney sweep with broom.
Keyleth reports Cerkonos confirmed Raishan infiltrated Pyrah disguised as a ~15-year-old human; Ashari didn’t know she was a dragon; she ripped open the rift then vanished.
Party debate next steps: options include confronting Kevdak for Titanstone Knuckles, visiting a sphinx (boyfriend) for aid, or going to a library.
Scanlan keeps summoning only chicken for meals; group jokes about food; minor.
Party chooses to head toward Westruun; targets: Grog’s herd on Silvercut Roadway area and possibly Frostweald/sphinx en route.
Grog reveals exile backstory: defied herd’s cruelty to a small bearded traveler; uncle Kevdak forced him to fight cousin (won) then Kevdak beat him nearly to death; herd likely thinks Grog is dead.
Matt: Grog’s herd roams Silvercut Roadway region—west of Westruun, south of Kraghammer, east of Emon; potential confrontation expected; Hat of Disguise option raised but Grog refuses to hide.
Group debates stealing Kevdak’s Titanstone Knuckles vs. direct fight; Grog warns Herd punish thieves brutally; suggests duel likely; wants more items first.
Plan shift: go to the sphinx in the Frostweald first to seek vestige info before confronting Grog’s Herd.
Umbrasyl (black) controls area from Gatshadow north of Westruun; Raishan not the dragon seen there.
Plan update: Instead of Crossroads, party Tree Strides to Bramblewood near Westruun, then Wind Walk south toward Frostweald.
From air near Westruun, they spot a 15–20 ft dirt patch with wood spikes, glimmering objects, haphazard grooves; two people carting something away.
Vex keeps broom but currently traveling via Wind Walk; Percy and Vex discuss custom broom seat/footholds design, Percy warns added cost.
Field site near Westruun is an offering spot: sweeping giant claw marks; pile of tossed gold/silver; likely dragon snatch pickups.
Party diverts to land near Westruun farmlands from Wind Walk; stealths in high crops. Pass Without Trace cast; all roll high stealth.
Westruun outskirts: farmers forced to work under armed guards; some fields and houses intentionally burned; thin outer wall/battlements added at city entrances.
Farmer Reginald confirms Westruun farmers are enslaved by dragon’s forces; guards take food and captives; caravans haven’t passed Westruun in a week.
Reginald: his daughter among captives; prisoners kept by guards near/in city; some slaughtered as warnings; points to an outpost on farm outskirts and toward city.
Reginald reports dragon (presumably Umbrasyl) seen about every couple days; last sighting dusk yesterday (~half day ago).
